name: @borjie/forecast-engine
description: Provider-abstraction forecasting engine: a classical accuracy floor (SeasonalNaive / ETS-Theta / Croston-TSB), a swappable TS-foundation-model provider port + registry, a split-conformal / CQR calibration wrapper, a horizon/regime portfolio router that rejects any model failing to beat the floor, MinT-lite hierarchical reconciliation, a prediction-APPEND port, and typed mining-estate + real-estate forecast targets. Every forecast carries >=1 evidence_id and APPENDS to (never replaces) rule-based decisions.
